distribution.narrative: Huang & Lu (2015) report Yunnan. Published geographic evidence only; original regional occurrence assessment remains unchanged and requires separate review. Existing note: Yin and Huang (1996) originally described Polygraphus querci as a new species from Xishuangbanna, Yunnan, China. Bright, in Bright and Skidmore (2002: 4), subsequently proposed Polygraphus yunnanensis as a replacement name because Polygraphus querci Yin & Huang, 1996 was a junior primary homonym of Polygraphus querci Wood, 1988. This is original type-locality evidence, but the China occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending independent review.

host_note: Yin and Huang (1996) recorded the holotype from Quercus acutissima (sawtooth oak) in Xishuangbanna, Yunnan. This published host association has not yet been independently reviewed and is therefore not listed as confirmed. The Huang & Lu (2015) record is a historical name crosswalk to Polygraphus yunnanensis; Quercus acutissima remains an unreviewed original host report, not promoted as confirmed.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Polygraphus yunnanensis Bright, 2002, a replacement name for Polygraphus querci Yin & Huang, 1996 (junior primary homonym of P. querci Wood, 1988).

taxonomic_history.name: Polygraphus querci
taxonomic_history.note: Originally described as a new species (sp. nov.) under the name Polygraphus querci by Yin & Huang (1996: 346). This name was subsequently recognized as a junior primary homonym of Polygraphus querci Wood, 1988.

taxonomic_history.name: Polygraphus yunnanensis
taxonomic_history.note: Bright (2002: 4) established Polygraphus yunnanensis as a replacement name (nomen novum) for Polygraphus querci Yin & Huang, 1996, not Polygraphus querci Wood, 1988. This was a change in nomenclature, not the description of another new species.

nomenclature_note: Do not combine the two Polygraphus querci names: Yin & Huang (1996) refers to this taxon and was replaced by Bright (2002); Wood (1988) is associated with P. kaimochii. The CO2015_081 record had previously been assigned to that different species in error.
